text:
anya: heads up — CI job 10421 failed during cache restore on runner-eu-2, blocking the deploy. error shows tar: unexpected EOF on /cache/layer-87.tar.gz
ci-bot: [automated] job 10421 failed: cache restore error (unexpected EOF). full: `/build/restore: tar: unexpected EOF while reading header
``
devin: looks like partial upload / truncated object in cache. saw background GC and an S3 5xx from eu-west yesterday.
jordan: can we repro by forcing cache miss? if we skip restore, does the build succeed?
anya: re-ran 10421 with SKIP_CACHE=1 -> build passes. so it's definitely cache layer corruption.
sam: runner-eu-2 disk pressure + intermittent s3 errors could have caused a partial write during shard sync.
mia: change window is still open. what's the appetite for manual unblock? we can pin to last-good image sha256:1b2c3d4e and run deploy-bot promote --image=sha256:1b2c3d4e --reason="manual-unblock-cache-truncation" --require=smoke
jordan: sound plan. confirm that sha256:1b2c3d4e passed the canary earlier today (it did).
devin: note: deploy-bot auto-promo blocked because CI job 10421 is red. manual promote will still trigger preflight checks; if those pass we can promote.
anya: triggering smoke on staging for sha256:1b2c3d4e now. ci-bot, kick it off?
ci-bot: kicked: smoke-2155 started against sha256:1b2c3d4e on staging. streaming logs: `smoke-2155: running health checks, db migrations dry-run, api smoke`
sam: while smoke runs, we should: 1) isolate affected cache shard (eu-2) 2) mark it read-only 3) enqueue resync job to rebuild missing layers from reliable mirrors 4) create short TTL for cache keys older than 24h
jordan: filed infra ticket IR-342 reshard + TTL, assigned to eng-infra and tagged eng-releases.
mia: smoke-2155 passed all checks :white_check_mark:. I'm OK to approve manual promote once we log the reason in release notes.
anya: mia approves. running: `deploy-bot promote --image=sha256:1b2c3d4e --by=mia --note="Manual promote due to cache restore EOF on runner-eu-2; follow-up IR-342"`
deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion initiated for sha256:1b2c3d4e by mia. Preflight checks running.
ci-bot: preflight on prod-canary completed OK.
anya: promotion completed, release promoted into prod within change window.
devin: follow-up: jordan to validate IR-342 reshard ran and to confirm eu-2 cache shard health before next release.
jordan: starting resync now, will post status in thread when done.
ci-bot: recommendation: add nightly-cache-integrity-check job that validates tar headers and checksum for newly uploaded layers, alert on partial writes.
mia: agreed; adding to next sprint board. also adding a short step to the release checklist: "verify cache shard health for runners used in promotion".
anya: noted. adding this thread to the release notes and postmortem with the fix and action items. closing after IR-342 verification.
